flowtrails.config.title: FlowTrails Settings
flowtrails.config.enabled.tooltip: Turn all trails on or off.
flowtrails.config.showSelf.tooltip: Show your own trails (third person / F5).
flowtrails.config.showSelfFirstPerson.to: Also show your own trails in first person. They can get in the way of your view.
flowtrails.config.maxDistance.tooltip: Players further away than this don't get trails.
flowtrails.config.opacity.tooltip: How see-through the trail is. 100% is fully solid at the head.
flowtrails.config.lifetime.tooltip: How long each part of the trail lingers before fading out.
flowtrails.config.glow.tooltip: Additive blending with a soft halo. Looks best on darker backgrounds.
flowtrails.config.rainbow.tooltip: Cycle through all colours. Overrides the colour above.
flowtrails.config.gradient.tooltip: Fade from the trail colour to the end colour along the trail.
